# Series 7 FT1, Made in India, for India

[Learn More][29]
Previous Next

## We acknowledge and appreciate the Indian Government’s decision to reduce the GST rate on solar PV
## modules from 12% to 5%. We expect this adjustment to be a meaningful step toward further
## improving the affordability of solar energy solutions. We remain committed to ensuring that the
## benefits of this reduction are reflected in our pricing — particularly for DCR modules supplied
## to initiatives such as PM-KUSUM.

[Series 7 FT1][30]

## Notice

It has come to our attention that First Solar, Inc’s name and logo might be used as part of a
suspected fraudulent company set up to solicit investment from individuals in India.

First Solar, Inc. is a publicly listed company on the NASDAQ stock exchange in the United States and
does not solicit investments or personal information via social media or instant messaging apps.
While this is out of our control, we are considering a range of legal options to address this issue.

यह हमारे ध्यान में आया है कि फर्स्ट सोलर, इंक का नाम और लोगो भारत में व्यक्तियों से निवेश मांगने के लिए स्थापित एक
संदिग्ध धोखाधड़ी कंपनी के हिस्से के रूप में इस्तेमाल किया जा सकता है।

फर्स्ट सोलर, इंक. संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में NASDAQ स्टॉक एक्सचेंज पर एक सार्वजनिक रूप से सूचीबद्ध कंपनी है और सोशल मीडिया
या इंस्टेंट मैसेजिंग ऐप्स के माध्यम से निवेश या व्यक्तिगत जानकारी नहीं मांगती है। हालाँकि यह हमारे नियंत्रण से बाहर है, हम
इस मुद्दे के समाधान के लिए कई कानूनी विकल्पों पर विचार कर रहे हैं।

## Responsible Solar

First Solar proudly established the guiding principles of Responsible Solar – how it treats its
employees, manages its environmental impact, and operates its business. Together, these pillars
produce a responsible solar technology that reduces risk and maximizes returns with respect for
people and the planet.

[Learn More][31]

## Innovative Technology

Derived from decades of leading-edge research and development, capital investment, trial and error,
and defining moments, First Solar’s Cadmium Telluride (CdTe) thin film technology is a product of
dedication. The company stands alone in the industry with its differentiated semiconductor and
streamlined manufacturing process, which yield unparalleled quality and reliability.

[Learn More][32]

## Made in India, for India

Designed and developed at its research and development (R&D) centers in California and Ohio, First
Solar’s advanced thin film PV modules set industry benchmarks for quality, durability, reliability,
design, and environmental performance. First Solar’s new factory in India is expected to produce a
PV module optimized for the country’s operating environment and needs. First Solar has operated in
the Indian market for over a decade and has already deployed over 2 GW of its modules in the
country.

[Learn More][33]

[Series 7 FT1][30]

## Notice

It has come to our attention that First Solar, Inc’s name and logo might be used as part of a
suspected fraudulent company set up to solicit investment from individuals in India.

First Solar, Inc. is a publicly listed company on the NASDAQ stock exchange in the United States and
does not solicit investments or personal information via social media or instant messaging apps.
While this is out of our control, we are considering a range of legal options to address this issue.

संदिग्ध धोखाधड़ी कंपनी के हिस्से के रूप में इस्तेमाल किया जा सकता है।

इस मुद्दे के समाधान के लिए कई कानूनी विकल्पों पर विचार कर रहे हैं।

## Responsible Solar

First Solar proudly established the guiding principles of Responsible Solar – how it treats its
employees, manages its environmental impact, and operates its business. Together, these pillars
produce a responsible solar technology that reduces risk and maximizes returns with respect for
people and the planet.

[Learn More][31]

## Innovative Technology

Derived from decades of leading-edge research and development, capital investment, trial and error,
and defining moments, First Solar’s Cadmium Telluride (CdTe) thin film technology is a product of
dedication. The company stands alone in the industry with its differentiated semiconductor and
streamlined manufacturing process, which yield unparalleled quality and reliability.

[Learn More][32]

## Made in India, for India

Designed and developed at its research and development (R&D) centers in California and Ohio, First
Solar’s advanced thin film PV modules set industry benchmarks for quality, durability, reliability,
design, and environmental performance. First Solar’s new factory in India is expected to produce a
PV module optimized for the country’s operating environment and needs. First Solar has operated in
the Indian market for over a decade and has already deployed over 2 GW of its modules in the
country.

## Delivering for America

Grids don’t build or modernize themselves, and resilience doesn’t happen by chance. It happens when
you advance with purpose. NextEra Energy is always building — power plants of all kinds,
infrastructure to fuel them and the network to move the power they generate from coast to coast. 

 

### FPL: Shaping Florida's Energy Future

As America's largest electric utility, Florida Power & Light Company serves more than 6 million
accounts, providing electricity to around 12 million people in Florida. Known for its fuel- and
cost-efficient power generation, FPL focuses on keeping bills low while driving energy innovation
and reliability. FPL is leading the way in supporting Florida’s growth with continuous
infrastructure advancements.

[Visit FPL][28]

### NextEra Energy Resources: An Energy Pioneer

NextEra Energy Resources is advancing America’s energy future with the largest and most diverse
portfolio of power generation and infrastructure solutions. As one of the nation's top wholesale
generators of electric power, it leverages all forms of energy across renewables, storage, natural
gas and nuclear. NextEra Energy Resources offers a wide range of integrated solutions to help
utilities and businesses across the country meet their energy needs when and where they need it.

# Sunnova Closure and Support Resources

## A Stronger Future Under New Ownership

Through Sunnova's court-supervised chapter 11 sale process, new owners have acquired substantially
all of Sunnova's assets and operations. Importantly, as part of the sale transaction, SunStrong
Management, an experienced full-service asset manager for the renewables industry, has assumed
responsibility for the servicing of the accounts for in-service customer systems acquired by the new
owner group, Sunnova has ceased independent operations. SunStrong Management has assumed
responsibility for servicing and managing most in-service customer systems—ensuring continuity of
operations, billing, and support for existing customers.

[Read the official announcement from Business Wire][1]

## Who Is SunStrong Management?

SunStrong Management is a full-service asset manager dedicated to the renewable-energy sector. Led
by seasoned industry veterans, SunStrong specializes in the management of existing residential solar
portfolios, including leases, loans, and power-purchase agreements.

SunStrong provides comprehensive services such as operations & maintenance, billing & collections,
and investor engagement, ensuring a stable, customer-first approach for every household they serve.

## What This Means for Sunnova Customers

If your account has transitioned to SunStrong, you should have already received communications
outlining next steps for maintaining your solar service, billing, and account access.

SunStrong's mission is to provide:
* Reliable service for your solar and storage systems
* Transparent, timely communication about your account
* Minimal disruption to your existing billing and performance tracking

Your payment arrangements remain the same. Please continue to make payments as usual until you
receive updated instructions directly from SunStrong.

## Questions About the Transition?

### What happened to Sunnova?

Through a competitive, court-supervised sale process, new owners acquired substantially all of
Sunnova's assets and operations to ensure long-term stability for customers, employees, and
partners.

### Who is managing my account now?

SunStrong Management has assumed customer-facing responsibilities for accounts acquired by the new
owner group, including system monitoring, billing, collections, and customer service.

### Will my payments or contract terms change?

No. You should continue your payments as usual. If any changes occur, SunStrong will notify you
directly with clear instructions.

### I had an in-progress installation. What happens next?

SunStrong is working with GoodLeap, a leading solar-market participant, to facilitate completion of
certain in-progress installations. You'll be contacted by your dealer or a GoodLeap representative
if your project qualifies.

For assistance with in-progress installations, contact GoodLeap at [(888) 975-5436][2] or
[[email protected]][3].

## Additional Resources
* Learn more about Sunnova's Chapter 11 proceedings: [restructuring.ra.kroll.com/Sunnova][4]
* For customer support inquiries, please refer to the contact information provided in your SunStrong
  welcome email.

Last Updated November 2, 2025

### Championing renewable energy developments that help you embrace sustainability.

BayWa r.e. develops renewable energy projects that help investors, developers, utility providers,
governments, and businesses to drive forward the energy transition. 

Like our partners, we’re on a mission to accelerate the global shift away from fossil fuels. We
unite leading expertise from across our industry to effect positive change using the latest
technologies. 

We are a leading integrated global renewable energy project developer and Independent Power Producer
(IPP) for wind, solar and battery storage systems, with dedicated expertise in Asset Operations and
Energy Trading. We are also a leading global supplier to the solar distribution market. Together,
we’re promoting renewable energies as part of our mission: for our planet!

# Series 7 FT1, Made in India, for India

[Learn More][29]
Previous Next

## We acknowledge and appreciate the Indian Government’s decision to reduce the GST rate on solar PV
## modules from 12% to 5%. We expect this adjustment to be a meaningful step toward further
## improving the affordability of solar energy solutions. We remain committed to ensuring that the
## benefits of this reduction are reflected in our pricing — particularly for DCR modules supplied
## to initiatives such as PM-KUSUM.

[Series 7 FT1][30]

## Notice

It has come to our attention that First Solar, Inc’s name and logo might be used as part of a
suspected fraudulent company set up to solicit investment from individuals in India.

First Solar, Inc. is a publicly listed company on the NASDAQ stock exchange in the United States and
does not solicit investments or personal information via social media or instant messaging apps.
While this is out of our control, we are considering a range of legal options to address this issue.

यह हमारे ध्यान में आया है कि फर्स्ट सोलर, इंक का नाम और लोगो भारत में व्यक्तियों से निवेश मांगने के लिए स्थापित एक
संदिग्ध धोखाधड़ी कंपनी के हिस्से के रूप में इस्तेमाल किया जा सकता है।

फर्स्ट सोलर, इंक. संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में NASDAQ स्टॉक एक्सचेंज पर एक सार्वजनिक रूप से सूचीबद्ध कंपनी है और सोशल मीडिया
या इंस्टेंट मैसेजिंग ऐप्स के माध्यम से निवेश या व्यक्तिगत जानकारी नहीं मांगती है। हालाँकि यह हमारे नियंत्रण से बाहर है, हम
इस मुद्दे के समाधान के लिए कई कानूनी विकल्पों पर विचार कर रहे हैं।

## Responsible Solar

First Solar proudly established the guiding principles of Responsible Solar – how it treats its
employees, manages its environmental impact, and operates its business. Together, these pillars
produce a responsible solar technology that reduces risk and maximizes returns with respect for
people and the planet.

[Learn More][31]

## Innovative Technology

Derived from decades of leading-edge research and development, capital investment, trial and error,
and defining moments, First Solar’s Cadmium Telluride (CdTe) thin film technology is a product of
dedication. The company stands alone in the industry with its differentiated semiconductor and
streamlined manufacturing process, which yield unparalleled quality and reliability.

[Learn More][32]

## Made in India, for India

Designed and developed at its research and development (R&D) centers in California and Ohio, First
Solar’s advanced thin film PV modules set industry benchmarks for quality, durability, reliability,
design, and environmental performance. First Solar’s new factory in India is expected to produce a
PV module optimized for the country’s operating environment and needs. First Solar has operated in
the Indian market for over a decade and has already deployed over 2 GW of its modules in the
country.

[Learn More][33]

# 
# Powering Today. Building Tomorrow.™

[Green horizontal line.]

 

## 100+ Years of Powering Progress

For more than a century, we’ve delivered stable, secure and scalable power solutions that revitalize
communities with new investments, new jobs and new purpose.

[Powering today. Building tomorrow]
[x][27]

## NextEra Energy is
## Delivering for America

Grids don’t build or modernize themselves, and resilience doesn’t happen by chance. It happens when
you advance with purpose. NextEra Energy is always building — power plants of all kinds,
infrastructure to fuel them and the network to move the power they generate from coast to coast. 

 

### FPL: Shaping Florida's Energy Future

As America's largest electric utility, Florida Power & Light Company serves more than 6 million
accounts, providing electricity to around 12 million people in Florida. Known for its fuel- and
cost-efficient power generation, FPL focuses on keeping bills low while driving energy innovation
and reliability. FPL is leading the way in supporting Florida’s growth with continuous
infrastructure advancements.

[Visit FPL][28]

### NextEra Energy Resources: An Energy Pioneer

NextEra Energy Resources is advancing America’s energy future with the largest and most diverse
portfolio of power generation and infrastructure solutions. As one of the nation's top wholesale
generators of electric power, it leverages all forms of energy across renewables, storage, natural
gas and nuclear. NextEra Energy Resources offers a wide range of integrated solutions to help
utilities and businesses across the country meet their energy needs when and where they need it.

[Visit NextEra Energy Resources][29]

### **We build and operate all forms of energy **

[diverse energy mix white outline icon]

**America's leading energy infrastructure builder**

[florida map white outline icon]

**Owner and operator of the largest electric utility in the U.S.**

[solar panels white outline icon]

**World leader in renewables¹**

[battery white outline icon]

**World leader in battery storage**

[nuclear symbol white outline]

**Operates one of America's largest nuclear fleets**

[electrical distribution lines white outline icon]

**America's leading transmission utility and leading competitive transmission developer**

[bar chart increase white outline icon]

**Better than top-decile operations across wind, solar, fossil and nuclear**

[ai artificial intelligence white outline icon]

**Industry leader in artificial intelligence and technology**

[Learn more][30]

### In Our Community

Across our company, more than 17,000 employees are actively giving back to the community. Whether
it's volunteering at local events or supporting animals in need, our people lead with heart. It’s
all part of our commitment to making a positive impact where we live and work.

### Join the Next Era

Discover your next opportunity at the forefront of the energy industry. Be part of a team that
powers American homes, businesses and dreams, now and in the future.

[Explore Careers][31]

Stay updated with the latest on company milestones, and how NextEra Energy is shaping the future of
power.

Go To The Source

## Chevron is your source for fuels and insights

From road and rail to marine and mining, our solutions support virtually every aspect of your
supply. We can help you meet today’s needs and get ahead of tomorrow’s targets with our diverse
portfolio of traditional fuels, biodiesel, renewable diesel, fuel blends, renewable compressed
natural gas (R-CNG) and hydrogen.
* [Go to the source][93]

Insights and Solutions

## Get insights and solutions on lower carbon fuels

Chevron experts provide insights and solutions on bio-based fuels. Ranging from understanding the
basics of biodiesel and renewable diesel and market segments to technical support and choosing the
right fuel. Use these insights to help you on your lower carbon journey.
* [Get insights][94]

Where To Find Fuels

## Find high-quality, lower carbon fuels

From the production of lower carbon fuel to filling up your tank, Chevron makes it convenient to be
your integrated low carbon fuel partner.
* [Find Chevron biodiesel and renewable diesel fuels][95]
* [Find Chevron Natural Gas Fuels][96]

Chevron Fuels Solutions

## Fuels for today, tomorrow and into the future

From road and rail to marine and mining, we offer a wide range of solutions to fuel virtually every
segment of the supply chain.
* [Learn More][97]

Our Advantage

## Leading the transformation to renewable fuels

We're providing fuel to help lead the way toward a lower carbon future by combining leading-edge
quality, go-to-market agility, sensible methods, innovation and strategic partnerships set us apart.
* [See the advantages of being a lower carbon partner][98]

Use Chevron's emissions calculator to estimate your Scope 1 GHG emissions by replacing petroleum
diesel with bio-based diesel fuels for your fleets.

# Sunnova Closure and Support Resources

## A Stronger Future Under New Ownership

Through Sunnova's court-supervised chapter 11 sale process, new owners have acquired substantially
all of Sunnova's assets and operations. Importantly, as part of the sale transaction, SunStrong
Management, an experienced full-service asset manager for the renewables industry, has assumed
responsibility for the servicing of the accounts for in-service customer systems acquired by the new
owner group, Sunnova has ceased independent operations. SunStrong Management has assumed
responsibility for servicing and managing most in-service customer systems—ensuring continuity of
operations, billing, and support for existing customers.

[Read the official announcement from Business Wire][1]

## Who Is SunStrong Management?

SunStrong Management is a full-service asset manager dedicated to the renewable-energy sector. Led
by seasoned industry veterans, SunStrong specializes in the management of existing residential solar
portfolios, including leases, loans, and power-purchase agreements.

SunStrong provides comprehensive services such as operations & maintenance, billing & collections,
and investor engagement, ensuring a stable, customer-first approach for every household they serve.

## What This Means for Sunnova Customers

If your account has transitioned to SunStrong, you should have already received communications
outlining next steps for maintaining your solar service, billing, and account access.

SunStrong's mission is to provide:
* Reliable service for your solar and storage systems
* Transparent, timely communication about your account
* Minimal disruption to your existing billing and performance tracking

Your payment arrangements remain the same. Please continue to make payments as usual until you
receive updated instructions directly from SunStrong.

## Questions About the Transition?

### What happened to Sunnova?

Through a competitive, court-supervised sale process, new owners acquired substantially all of
Sunnova's assets and operations to ensure long-term stability for customers, employees, and
partners.

### Who is managing my account now?

SunStrong Management has assumed customer-facing responsibilities for accounts acquired by the new
owner group, including system monitoring, billing, collections, and customer service.

### Will my payments or contract terms change?

No. You should continue your payments as usual. If any changes occur, SunStrong will notify you
directly with clear instructions.

### I had an in-progress installation. What happens next?

SunStrong is working with GoodLeap, a leading solar-market participant, to facilitate completion of
certain in-progress installations. You'll be contacted by your dealer or a GoodLeap representative
if your project qualifies.

For assistance with in-progress installations, contact GoodLeap at [(888) 975-5436][2] or
[[email protected]][3].

## Additional Resources
* Learn more about Sunnova's Chapter 11 proceedings: [restructuring.ra.kroll.com/Sunnova][4]
* For customer support inquiries, please refer to the contact information provided in your SunStrong
  welcome email.

Last Updated November 2, 2025

environmental stewardship, social responsibility, and economic empowerment. By joining Ancient
Society, you are contributing to a positive and lasting impact on the world.

## r.e.think energy

### Championing renewable energy developments that help you embrace sustainability.

BayWa r.e. develops renewable energy projects that help investors, developers, utility providers,
governments, and businesses to drive forward the energy transition. 

Like our partners, we’re on a mission to accelerate the global shift away from fossil fuels. We
unite leading expertise from across our industry to effect positive change using the latest
technologies. 

We are a leading integrated global renewable energy project developer and Independent Power Producer
(IPP) for wind, solar and battery storage systems, with dedicated expertise in Asset Operations and
Energy Trading. We are also a leading global supplier to the solar distribution market. Together,
we’re promoting renewable energies as part of our mission: for our planet!  

## How can we help you?

Whatever your renewable energy goals, we’re your trustworthy expert partner.

##### Project development and realisation

End-to-end implementation of renewables projects, creating lucrative investment opportunities.  

[Find out more][8]

##### Asset operations

Managing utility-scale projects, keeping them operational and optimised.

[Find out more][9]

##### Revamping and repowering

Restoring ageing wind and PV projects to peak operational capacity and/or increasing their capacity.

[Find out more][10]

##### Energy trading

Representing your energy market interests across Europe.

[Find out more][11]

##### Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs)

A revolutionary way to connect companies and renewable energy producers with green electricity.

[Find out more][12]

##### Independent Power Producer (IPP)

We own, operate and manage a global renewable energy portfolio.

[Find out more][13]

## Current press releases

Get the latest updates on BayWa r.e. and our renewable energy projects around the world.  

20 July 2026

##### BayWa r.e. and Rheinland Solar deploy a 10 MWh BESS to maximise self-consumption

BayWa r.e. Solar Energy Systems GmbH, part of BayWa r.e. Solar Trade, and Rheinland Solar GmbH are
deploying a battery energy storage system with a capacity of 10 MWh for Pfalzmarkt für Obst und
Gemüse eG in Mutterstadt. The solution enables excess solar energy that would otherwise be curtailed
to be stored and used when needed, significantly increasing the self-consumption of the existing PV
system.

# Powering The Future

Providing clean, dependable power to people and businesses.

[ Discover Who We Are ][17] [ Opportunities with Brookfield ][18]

Brookfield Renewable North America is part of Brookfield’s global renewable platform, with hydro,
wind, solar, and storage assets across Canada and the United States. We bring together operational
excellence, a strong safety culture, and long-term partnerships to deliver energy solutions that
support the transition to a lower-carbon future.

[ Explore Our Expertise ][19]
Your browser does not support the video tag.
KEY FACTS & STATISTICS

## Delivering Clean Power

We deliver reliable clean power across Canada and the United States. The strength of our business is
built on sustainable power generation through our core technologies across hydro, wind, solar, and
storage assets. This infrastructure is the backbone of our energy system and allows us to provide
long-term value to customers.

COMMUNITY AT OUR CORE

## We're committed to being more than just operators

We’re more than owners and operators: we’re partners, collaborators, and stewards of the places we
serve. Our commitment goes beyond generating power to creating lasting impact through safety,
community engagement, and respectful relationships with Indigenous Peoples. It’s how we build trust,
deliver value, and help shape a more sustainable future.

### A Culture of Safety

Safety is non-negotiable. It’s at the core of everything we do. Through our world-class Health,
Safety, Security & Environment (HSS&E) program, we foster a strong safety culture across our teams,
contractors, and operations. We work closely with local communities to promote public safety around
our facilities, including water safety near dams, electrical awareness, and emergency preparedness.
Whether on site or in the surrounding area, safety is always our top priority.

[ Our Public Safety Initiatives ][20]

### Community Impact

We’re proud to be part of the communities where we live and work. Our approach goes beyond
investment. We build relationships, listen to local priorities, and collaborate on initiatives that
make a meaningful difference. Whether it’s partnering on education, recreation, or economic
development, we aim to support long-term resilience and shared success.

[ Building Stronger Communities ][21]

Be part of a dynamic, inclusive culture
where collaboration and creativity drive exceptional service.

### Welcome to Brunel. 

Behind every major project are people most of us never see. The engineers, technicians, project
leaders and technical specialists powering the electricity in our homes, the materials we depend on,
the infrastructure that connects us, and the essential industries we depend on every day.


For over[50 years][48], Brunel has helped the world's leading businesses find and mobilise
specialist talent for some of the most critical projects and industries on the planet, wherever, and
whenever, they're needed.

Whether you're delivering a major project, scaling operations across borders, or solving your next
workforce challenge, our global recruitment specialists are here to help you find the people who
make it possible.

[ [take your pleasure seriously: play as a way of being] ][48]

### [ take your pleasure seriously: play as a way of being ][49]

what if form didn't follow function, but pleasure? long before we built anything, we played, turning
a cardboard box into a spaceship and a patch of floor into an ocean. play here is not frivolity, but
our first creative act, the moment imagination learns that reality is negotiable. this chapter
explores what happens when we design not to save time, but to spend it well, rejecting efficiency as
the highest virtue in favor of warmth, spontaneity, and joy. to choose delight while the world feels
heavy is not to look away from it, but to remember what makes it worth carrying.

by sofia lekka angelopoulou

## Trusted by Industry & Financial Leaders

From energy to infrastructure and beyond – leading companies rely on Energix for sustainable
solutions, long-term partnerships, and proven results.

### First Solar

Our long-term framework agreement with First Solar secures up to 7GW of U.S.-manufactured solar
panels through 2030, reinforcing our commitment to supply chain stability, advanced technology, and
responsible domestic manufacturing. This partnership strengthens our ability to scale reliably while
supporting the growth of clean energy across the United States.

### Google

Through a strategic framework agreement, we secured long-term power purchase agreements and tax
equity investments totaling at least 1.5GW through 2030. This collaboration provides financial
certainty, accelerates project execution, and supports the scalable deployment of large-scale
renewable energy assets.

### SMA AG

Our strategic collaboration with SMA AG includes the procurement of 1.5GW of advanced inverters
through 2029, supporting the reliable deployment of large-scale solar projects across the U.S. This
partnership ensures access to proven technology, long-term performance, and system stability at
scale.

### Santander

With USD 635 million in financing from Santander, we strengthened our financial foundation to
advance large-scale renewable energy projects. This partnership reflects strong institutional
confidence in our strategy, portfolio quality, and long-term growth across key markets.

### MUFG

Our USD 490 million financing agreement with MUFG supports the continued development and expansion
of our renewable energy portfolio. This collaboration underscores global financial confidence in our
projects and enables the scalable deployment of clean energy solutions across key markets.

### Morgan Stanley

Our USD 380 million tax equity investment from Morgan Stanley strengthens our capacity to accelerate
renewable energy projects while delivering long-term value. This partnership highlights strong
institutional support for our growth strategy and commitment to sustainable energy solutions.

economies locally and globally.

**AUTOMATION**

## Our new product highlights

### Reserva—the Fronius storage solution

Use solar energy around the clock with the Fronius Reserva. The high-voltage battery with DC
coupling ensures a highly efficient energy transfer. Thanks to its modular capacity of 6.3 to 15.8
kWh, the Reserva can be flexibly adapted to your needs. Designed to work seamlessly with Fronius
hybrid inverters, it slots perfectly into your PV system. Your data remains secure on European
servers, while our proven service and support network is always there for you.

[Learn more about the Fronius Reserva][7]

### Fronius Fortis—the next-gen manual MIG/MAG welding machine

Welding tasks are often a challenge, especially for small and medium-sized companies. Some of the
tasks change on a daily basis, as do the required welding processes. This calls for a welding
machine that can be adapted perfectly to these dynamic conditions.

**Fronius is a global corporation specializing in **welding technology, photovoltaics, and battery
charging technology.**

Since **1945**, we have been developing solutions that stand for **quality, reliability, and
durability.** With around 6,500 employees in **37 subsidiaries,** we focus on innovation and
sustainability in order to provide our customers around the world with the best possible products
and services.

Guided by the principle of “Connecting what matters”, we connect people, materials, and energy to
build a **safe and sustainable world.**

Fronius Solar & Energy
Electricity is the thread that binds our business and our world together. By focusing on energy
sector integration, our solutions connect the sun with the grid, the grid with mobility, and energy
systems with efficiency.
[Discover Fronius Solar & Energy][3]
Fronius Welding
Our welding technology is designed to forge unbreakable bonds between metals for decades to come.
[Discover Fronius Welding][4]
About us

Latest news

## Our new product highlights

### Reserva—the Fronius storage solution

Use solar energy around the clock with the Fronius Reserva. The high-voltage battery with DC
coupling ensures a highly efficient energy transfer. Thanks to its modular capacity of 6.3 to 15.8
kWh, the Reserva can be flexibly adapted to your needs. Designed to work seamlessly with Fronius
hybrid inverters, it slots perfectly into your PV system. Your data remains secure on European
servers, while our proven service and support network is always there for you.

[Learn more about the Fronius Reserva][7]
[Fronius Reserva]

### Fronius Fortis—the next-gen manual MIG/MAG welding machine

Welding tasks are often a challenge, especially for small and medium-sized companies. Some of the
tasks change on a daily basis, as do the required welding processes. This calls for a welding
machine that can be adapted perfectly to these dynamic conditions.

[Learn more about the Fronius Fortis][8]

# Expertise                                                                                         
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
I am an innovation researcher with an interest in policy, history, society, theory and research     
methodology. As a multidisciplinary researcher I have written 200+ articles on eco-innovation,      
sustainability transitions and transformative social innovation in a wide range of disciplinary and 
multidisciplinary journals: innovation journals, environmental and ecological economics journals,   
policy journals, transport journals, and sustainable development journals. I am editor of           
*Environmental Innovation and Societal Transformation*s, *Sustainability Science* and advisory      
editor of *Research Policy* (top-tier journals on innovation and sustainability). As a professor of 
innovation and sustainable development I try to do socially relevant research and offer policy      
advice to create a better world (see consultation for policy).                                      
                                                                                                    
I wrote seminal articles and books on technological regime shifts, strategic niche management,      
transition management and reflexive governance for sustainable development. To me innovation is not 
a simple solution but comes with risks, imperfections and side-effects that have to be addressed.   
                                                                                                    
In the last 8 years, I developed a great interest in the humanisation of the economy through social 
innovation. There is a [video][18] for those interested in my views and an [interview][19].         
                                                                                                    
I have an interest in institutional theory: the role of institutional logics and the agency of      
actors in changing them. An interesting question is: *How is it possible that institutions…can arise
without a common will aiming at their creation [is] the significant, perhaps the most significant   
problem of the social sciences* – Carl Menger

## Featured Programs and Rebates

Program

### Level Pay

Monthly billing is here! Level Pay is a new, convenient monthly bill payment option that helps you
budget for your LADWP bill and pay off past due amounts.

[ Learn more ][71]
Program

### Landscape Efficiency Assistance Program

Free services for lawn removal and replacement with California Friendly® landscaping.

[ Learn more ][72]
Program

### EZ Save

The EZ-SAVE Program helps income-qualified customers save on their LADWP bills.

[ Learn more ][73]
Program

### Solar Programs

A key element of LADWP’s renewable energy program is the development of local solar, particularly
customer based programs that tap into the city’s abundant sunshine and provide residents and
businesses with the ability to generate their own power.

[ Learn more ][74]
Program

### Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP)

Helps eligible income-qualified households to manage and meet their immediate home heating and/or
cooling needs.

[ Learn more ][75]
Program

### Senior Citizen / Disability Lifeline Rate

The Lifeline Rate Program is a City of LA Office of Finance program that offers senior and disabled
citizens an exemption on their electric and other utility bills. This rate is available under
provisions of the Los Angeles Municipal Code or the Revenue and Taxation Code of the State of
California.

[ Learn more ][76]
Program

### Cool LA

Cool LA is designed to help LADWP customers better manage the impacts of extreme heat caused by
climate change, especially older adults, income-qualified families, and those living in underserved
communities where hot weather has an especially significant impact.

[ Learn more ][77]
Program

### Water Insights

LADWP’s My Water Insights is a free home water management program designed to help customers better
understand their water use through home water reports and a user-friendly online portal.

[ Learn more ][78]

## Featured Programs and Rebates

Program

### Level Pay

Monthly billing is here! Level Pay is a new, convenient monthly bill payment option that helps you
budget for your LADWP bill and pay off past due amounts.

[ Learn more ][71]
Program

### Landscape Efficiency Assistance Program

Free services for lawn removal and replacement with California Friendly® landscaping.

[ Learn more ][72]
Program

### EZ Save

The EZ-SAVE Program helps income-qualified customers save on their LADWP bills.

[ Learn more ][73]
Program

### Solar Programs

A key element of LADWP’s renewable energy program is the development of local solar, particularly
customer based programs that tap into the city’s abundant sunshine and provide residents and
businesses with the ability to generate their own power.

[ Learn more ][74]
Program

### Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP)

Helps eligible income-qualified households to manage and meet their immediate home heating and/or
cooling needs.

[ Learn more ][75]
Program

### Senior Citizen / Disability Lifeline Rate

The Lifeline Rate Program is a City of LA Office of Finance program that offers senior and disabled
citizens an exemption on their electric and other utility bills. This rate is available under
provisions of the Los Angeles Municipal Code or the Revenue and Taxation Code of the State of
California.

[ Learn more ][76]
Program

### Cool LA

Cool LA is designed to help LADWP customers better manage the impacts of extreme heat caused by
climate change, especially older adults, income-qualified families, and those living in underserved
communities where hot weather has an especially significant impact.

[ Learn more ][77]
Program

### Water Insights

LADWP’s My Water Insights is a free home water management program designed to help customers better
understand their water use through home water reports and a user-friendly online portal.

[ Learn more ][78]

## Together, we capture the wind to power a sustainable world


With almost 50 years of innovation that continues to shape the wind industry, LM Wind Power is a
pioneer in advancing wind turbine blade technology and setting new standards for sustainability,
efficiency, and digital industrialization

[Learn More][49]

LM Wind Power is part of GE Vernova, in a joint effort to power a cleaner world and unleash
limitless energy.

With almost five decades of experience, we have established ourselves as the preferred supplier of
wind turbine blades worldwide. In fact, almost every fifth turbine in the world is fitted with LM
Wind Power blades. This includes thousands of GE turbines on land and in the sea. 

Our long-standing partnership with GE has yielded many innovations and commercial successes. Now, as
part of [GE Vernova][50], together we can offer higher performing, more productive wind turbines,
while continuing to reduce the cost of energy, increase energy independance, and improve returns on
our customers’ investments. At the same time, we are equally committed to maintaining and growing
our business with all customers.

## Global Strategic Initiatives

The energy transition is about investing in people as well as projects. Masdar’s strategic
initiatives empower women and young people to become sustainability leaders, reward grassroots
sustainability solutions and foster global collaboration.

## Abu Dhabi Sustainability Week

Abu Dhabi Sustainability Week (ADSW) is a global sustainability platform that convenes world leaders
to develop action-oriented solutions to the most pressing challenge of our time: climate change.

attendees

## 175

countries represented

## 600

speakers from around the world

## Youth 4 Sustainability

The main objective of Y4S is to reach up to one million youth by 2030 through a blended learning
experience, to create awareness of the skills needed for future jobs in sustainability, and to
support the growth of the next generation of sustainability leaders through the Future
Sustainability Leaders and Sustainability Ambassadors programs, and global outreach activities.

## +535k

youth connected via social media

## +39k

young people engaged with Y4S online and in-person activations

## 183

workshops and training sessions

## WiSER

Women in Sustainability, Environment and Renewable Energy (WiSER) is a global platform dedicated to
inspiring women to play an active role in addressing global sustainability challenges.

## +470

hours of one-to-one mentorship

## +215

hours of workshops with WiSER pioneers

## Qui sommes-nous ?

Créée en 2008, Neoen est l’un des leaders mondiaux des énergies renouvelables. Ses savoir-faire dans
les domaines du solaire, de l’éolien terrestre et du stockage lui permettent d’accélérer la
transition énergétique des pays dans lesquels Neoen produit une énergie verte, locale et
compétitive. Nos capacités en construction, en operation ou sous gestion s’élèvent à 9,3 GW et nous
avons pour ambition d’atteindre 20 GW en 2030.

  2025, with cages declining and barns remaining a small share. Source: Defra (2023, 2026). License:

  Today
  
  ### Three-quarters of eggs produced in the United Kingdom are free-range
  
  Hannah Ritchie and Pablo Rosado
  
  Growing up in the United Kingdom in the 1990s and early 2000s, almost all the eggs in our
  supermarket came from battery hens, those raised in small wire enclosures.
  
  The living conditions in these cages are terrible. Birds get the space equivalent of an A4 sheet
  of paper. They don’t have the room to carry out their natural behaviors, such as nesting,
  perching, or dust bathing.
  
  That has changed in recent decades. You can see this in the chart, which shows the conditions
  under which eggs are produced in the UK. Free-range eggs have increased from just 10% to 75%.
  
  The use of caged hens has fallen, and the types of caged enclosures have also changed. Battery
  cages were banned in 2012, so legally, all cages since then have been “enriched” ones, which
  provide slightly more space. Still, these do not give hens the freedom and room they’d have in
  barns or free-range farms. Studies suggest that moving hens from enriched cages to cage-free
  systems reduces the time they spend in pain by more than half.
  
  And given that most eggs in the UK are now free-range, it’s possible to reduce this pain even
  further.
  
  Read my article on what the conditions of hens look like under caged versus cage-free systems

[Engineers and field crew review a utility-scale solar array during solar SCADA commissioning and

and site acceptance support—so your plant data is trusted from day one

monitoring dashboards to match your reporting, compliance, and O&M workflows.

[Field technician uses a laptop to verify solar data acquisition system (DAS) points and

Our [RenergyWare hardware][26] and integration approach support clean communications, reliable data
acquisition, and scalable monitoring—designed for real-world utility-scale conditions.

# Deep Cycle & LiFePO4 Lithium Batteries

Rolls premium deep cycle lead-acid batteries, and LiFePO4 lithium options, offer reliable and
long-lasting energy storage solutions for Marine, Motive Power, Railroad & Renewable Energy
applications.

[View Batteries][8] [Find a Distributor][9]

## News

**April 1, 2026: Emergency Fuel Surcharges**

To: All Valued Customers – Implementation of Emergency Fuel Surcharges – Effective Apr 1, 2026…
[read more][10]

**UL 9540**–listed DC BESS, including Rolls new **[S48-100LFP STACK-LV][11]**, may now be paired
with any **CSA C22.2 No. 107.1/UL 1741** certified inverters, improving flexibility and project
efficiency while meeting safety standards—[learn more][12].

**Introducing the latest LiFePO4 lithium option from Rolls!**

Designed for 48-volt system integration, the **[S48-100LFP STACK-LV ][13]**
51.2V 100Ah LFP ESS battery offers up to 40kWh energy storage (8 modules) in a convenient stackable
format. This new model features long-lasting 100Ah prismatic LiFePO4 cells, an onboard display with
status indication, dual M8 threaded terminals and included busbars for easy connection, RS485 & CAN
inverter connectivity, PC management software, Bluetooth connection & Rolls LFP Connect App,
built-in BMS with a full suite of operating protections, as well as BMS switch, relay & side-mounted
breaker protection for added safety. 

UL 9540, UL 9540A & UL 1973 certified.

See the full specs [here][14].

## About Rolls Battery

#### History

Established in 1935, Surrette Battery Company Ltd. is proud to be one of North America’s leading
lead-acid battery producers and Canada’s only remaining independent battery manufacturer. Since
1959, the company has been located in Springhill, Nova Scotia, where we produce a wide range of
Rolls-branded premium deep cycle batteries for use in Renewable Energy, Marine, Motive Power and
Railroad applications. Rolls flooded and sealed AGM & GEL VRLA products are internationally
recognized for their dependability, cycle life and outstanding quality.

#### Availability

Rolls Batteries are sold exclusively via our valued distributors & battery dealers. As a
longstanding manufacturer, Surrette Battery Company has been successful in negotiating and
establishing key partnerships with leading battery distributors and dealers throughout North America
and around the World. Due to product specifications and weight, these agreements and the ability to
ship and warehouse in large volumes have allowed us to improve lead times and minimize the
associated freight costs, improving access and delivery to product for dealers and their customers.

#### Manufacturing

Surrette Battery Company Ltd. manufacturing plant is an ISO registered facility where safety is as
important as product quality. Meeting the needs of our distributors who serve growing Renewable
Energy and Motive Power markets around the globe, we’ve completed numerous expansions and upgrades
in recent years and continue to advance our manufacturing facility and processes to meet demand.

We take pride in our reputation as industry leaders in providing high quality, dependable products
and see customer satisfaction and support as the key to future success. Rigorous inspection and
testing ensure that each battery will deliver the performance our customers have come to expect of
the Rolls brand.

## SEMA Coalition Comments on HUD's Build America, Buy America RFI

][25]

## WE TAKE ACTION

### The SEMA Coalition is reviving American solar manufacturing, advocating for policies to reshore
### a competitive and innovative solar supply chain to help meet our growing energy demand, create
### thousands of well-paying jobs, and secure our nation’s energy independence.

[About SEMA][26]

## What does SEMA

[advocate image]

## advocate for?

Our coalition is focused on supporting American solar manufacturers and rebuilding the domestic
solar supply chain. Founded in 2021, the SEMA Coalition initially advocated for the Solar Energy
Manufacturing for America Act, which now enacted as part of the Section 45X Advanced Manufacturing
Production Tax Credit. The coalition promotes U.S. manufacturing and job growth in solar. As a
leading voice, we urge policymakers to adopt a whole-of-government approach to restore the domestic
solar supply chain and build a secure, made-in-America energy future.

## ABOUT US

Solar Tech Is A Leading South African Importer And Wholesaler Of Premium Solar Energy Solutions,
Passionately Committed To Harnessing The Power Of Nature To Combat The Country’s Persistent
Loadshedding Challenges

With Operational Hubs In Cape Town, Gauteng, And Kwazulu‑Natal, Solar Tech Wholesalers Supplies
Trusted Installers And Resellers Nationwide, Backed By A Streamlined Customer Application Process
And Dedicated Support Teams In Each Region.

**Our Mission:** To Accelerate The Adoption Of Renewable Energy In South Africa By Distributing
High-Quality, Reliable Products That Empower Homes And Businesses To Become Energy-Resilient.

**Our Vision:** A Future Where South Africans Can Confidently Power Their Lives, Free From Grids And
Blackouts, Through Sustainable Energy Independence.

We aspire to be the d*efinitive* organization in support of renewable energy in the USA.

Established in 2008, the United States Renewable Energy Association (USREA) is a membership-based
association that promotes sustainable energy, alternative energy, energy efficiency, and clean
renewable technologies.

Our association members include people that believe in renewable energy, businesses and schools in
the renewable industry, customers and most importantly You!

[Read more here.][28]
* [
  
  #### Why Join?
  
  ][29]

When you become a USREA Member, you partner with us to expand renewable energy throughout America
and you help affect policies that cause renewable energy to prosper. Your membership helps us to
promote and grow the renewable energy economy.

As an Individual, Business, or corporate member you are eligible to receive many benefits and
incentives. USREA Business members get important credibility, industry recognition, and visibility
within the USREA Membership Directory.

[Read more here.][30]
* [
  
  #### Become a Member
  
  ][31]

Your Membership in USREA connects you to the Companies, Events, Advertising, News and Policies that
affect the R.E. Industry.

[Read more here.][32]

Association, with a mission to promote the clean-tech industry by and through our members. If you

Thank you for Supporting Renewable Energy Independence Day

Renewable Energy Independence Day™ is an initiative of the US Renewable Energy Association
(USREA.org). The Nationwide Petition Drive asks Congress for a declaration of July 3rd as a date
where national efforts toward achieving renewable energy use of (50.4%), as compared to
non-renewable energy resources is acknowledged as a goal. This initiative supports the idea that
before the U.S. can truly have Independence Day on July 4th, the U.S. must achieve Renewable Energy
Independence.

The current national percentage of Renewable Energy Electricity use in 2019 (Approx 17%), represents
a current Renewable Energy Day of March 2nd, (if a one year supply of renewable energy electric were
used exclusively beginning January 1st, it would last until March 2nd). The goal of the United
States Renewable Energy Association, along with supporting companies and like minded individuals, is
to have a goal declaring July 3rd as the nationally recognized tipping point goal in clean energy
production. It is structured somewhat like Tax Freedom Day.

The petition is available at usrea.org and is supported by multiple National Alternative Energy
companies, associations and individuals. The goal is to have 200K signatures available before July
in a national social media campaign delivered to the U.S. Congress.

United States
In the United States, Renewable Energy Day for 2020 is March 2nd for a total average effective use
rate of 17% of the nation\'s energy use based on published data from the U.S. Energy Information
Administration. (In 2015, the energy use was February 18th and 13% )

Renewable Energy Day is the first day of the year in which a nation as a whole has theoretically
switched from Renewable Energy use, from all sources, and moved to the balance of yearly energy
production from non-renewable sources such as coal, petroleum, natural gas, nuclear, etc.

Purpose
According to Gerald B. Zack, President/CEO, USREA, “The purpose of Renewable Energy Independence Day
is to provide US citizens a metric with which to estimate progress in the use and deployment of
Renewable Energy Technologies. The premise is that by comparing the relative energy use in a date
reference, progress toward the tipping point of July 3rd can more easily be assessed.“

The petition language will be sent to the U.S. House of Representatives and U.S. Senate in the
following form:

Dear Speaker Pelosi, Leader McConnell, Leader McCarthy, Leader Schumer:

point of more than 50% renewable energy use in the U.S. in a manner similar to tax freedom day. July
3rd is 50.4% into the calendar year, and as such can become an ambitious but achievable goal.

your aspirations into reality. Whether you are an entrepreneur, innovator, or someone with a vision
for a better future, Ancient Society is the place where you can build your dreams and watch them
grow into success.

We offer a wide range of programs and initiatives designed to support individuals at every stage of
their journey. From mentorship and training to funding and networking, we provide the tools you need
to succeed.

## Innovative Projects:

Our diverse ecosystem includes groundbreaking projects in technology, agriculture, energy, and more.
These initiatives not only create opportunities for personal growth but also contribute to the
development and prosperity of our communities.

We collaborate with experts and leaders from around the world to bring the best practices and
cutting-edge knowledge to our members. This global perspective ensures that you are equipped with
the skills and insights needed to thrive in an ever-changing world.

At Ancient Society, you are part of a vibrant and supportive community. We believe in the power of
collaboration and work together to achieve common goals. Our network of like-minded individuals and
organizations provides a strong foundation for your success.

## Sustainability and Impact

We are committed to creating a sustainable future for all. Our projects are designed with a focus on
environmental stewardship, social responsibility, and economic empowerment. By joining Ancient
Society, you are contributing to a positive and lasting impact on the world.

## Entrepreneurship and Innovation:

Many of our members have turned their innovative ideas into successful businesses through our
entrepreneurship programs. By providing access to funding, mentorship, and resources, we help
startups and small businesses flourish.

**Инвертор (ИБП) ANENJ 2000W 12V**

Гибридный инвертор ANENJI 2000W 12V — это многофункциональное устройство, объединяющее в себе
инвертор, солнечный MPPT-контроллер, зарядное устройство и систему автоматического переключения
питания. Он предназначен для создания автономных или резервных систем электроснабжения в домах,
дачах, мастерских, а также для мобильных решений (кемперы, яхты и т.д.).

**ANENJI LiFePO4, емкость 100Ah, 12 В**

Литий-железо-фосфатная батарея ANENJI LiFePO4, емкость 100Ah, 12 В

ANENJI LiFePO4 — это высокоэффективная литий-железо-фосфатная батарея, разработанная для
использования в солнечных системах, резервных источниках питания и других приложениях, требующих
стабильного и долговечного источника энергии. Эти аккумуляторы отличаются высокой безопасностью,
долговечностью и отличной производительностью.

# Powering The Future

Providing clean, dependable power to people and businesses.

[ Discover Who We Are ][17] [ Opportunities with Brookfield ][18]

Brookfield Renewable North America is part of Brookfield’s global renewable platform, with hydro,
wind, solar, and storage assets across Canada and the United States. We bring together operational
excellence, a strong safety culture, and long-term partnerships to deliver energy solutions that
support the transition to a lower-carbon future.

[ Explore Our Expertise ][19]
Your browser does not support the video tag.
KEY FACTS & STATISTICS

## Delivering Clean Power

We deliver reliable clean power across Canada and the United States. The strength of our business is
built on sustainable power generation through our core technologies across hydro, wind, solar, and
storage assets. This infrastructure is the backbone of our energy system and allows us to provide
long-term value to customers.

COMMUNITY AT OUR CORE

## We're committed to being more than just operators

We’re more than owners and operators: we’re partners, collaborators, and stewards of the places we
serve. Our commitment goes beyond generating power to creating lasting impact through safety,
community engagement, and respectful relationships with Indigenous Peoples. It’s how we build trust,
deliver value, and help shape a more sustainable future.

### A Culture of Safety

Safety is non-negotiable. It’s at the core of everything we do. Through our world-class Health,
Safety, Security & Environment (HSS&E) program, we foster a strong safety culture across our teams,
contractors, and operations. We work closely with local communities to promote public safety around
our facilities, including water safety near dams, electrical awareness, and emergency preparedness.
Whether on site or in the surrounding area, safety is always our top priority.

[ Our Public Safety Initiatives ][20]

### Community Impact

We’re proud to be part of the communities where we live and work. Our approach goes beyond
investment. We build relationships, listen to local priorities, and collaborate on initiatives that
make a meaningful difference. Whether it’s partnering on education, recreation, or economic
development, we aim to support long-term resilience and shared success.

[ Building Stronger Communities ][21]

### Welcome to Brunel. 

Behind every major project are people most of us never see. The engineers, technicians, project
leaders and technical specialists powering the electricity in our homes, the materials we depend on,
the infrastructure that connects us, and the essential industries we depend on every day.

specialist talent for some of the most critical projects and industries on the planet, wherever, and
whenever, they're needed.

Whether you're delivering a major project, scaling operations across borders, or solving your next
workforce challenge, our global recruitment specialists are here to help you find the people who
make it possible.

[ [take your pleasure seriously: play as a way of being] ][48]

### [ take your pleasure seriously: play as a way of being ][49]

what if form didn't follow function, but pleasure? long before we built anything, we played, turning
a cardboard box into a spaceship and a patch of floor into an ocean. play here is not frivolity, but
our first creative act, the moment imagination learns that reality is negotiable. this chapter
explores what happens when we design not to save time, but to spend it well, rejecting efficiency as
the highest virtue in favor of warmth, spontaneity, and joy. to choose delight while the world feels
heavy is not to look away from it, but to remember what makes it worth carrying.

by sofia lekka angelopoulou

## Trusted by Industry & Financial Leaders

From energy to infrastructure and beyond – leading companies rely on Energix for sustainable
solutions, long-term partnerships, and proven results.

### First Solar

Our long-term framework agreement with First Solar secures up to 7GW of U.S.-manufactured solar
panels through 2030, reinforcing our commitment to supply chain stability, advanced technology, and
responsible domestic manufacturing. This partnership strengthens our ability to scale reliably while
supporting the growth of clean energy across the United States.

### Google

Through a strategic framework agreement, we secured long-term power purchase agreements and tax
equity investments totaling at least 1.5GW through 2030. This collaboration provides financial
certainty, accelerates project execution, and supports the scalable deployment of large-scale
renewable energy assets.

### SMA AG

Our strategic collaboration with SMA AG includes the procurement of 1.5GW of advanced inverters
through 2029, supporting the reliable deployment of large-scale solar projects across the U.S. This
partnership ensures access to proven technology, long-term performance, and system stability at
scale.

### Santander

With USD 635 million in financing from Santander, we strengthened our financial foundation to
advance large-scale renewable energy projects. This partnership reflects strong institutional
confidence in our strategy, portfolio quality, and long-term growth across key markets.

### MUFG

Our USD 490 million financing agreement with MUFG supports the continued development and expansion
of our renewable energy portfolio. This collaboration underscores global financial confidence in our
projects and enables the scalable deployment of clean energy solutions across key markets.

### Morgan Stanley

Our USD 380 million tax equity investment from Morgan Stanley strengthens our capacity to accelerate
renewable energy projects while delivering long-term value. This partnership highlights strong
institutional support for our growth strategy and commitment to sustainable energy solutions.

## Our new product highlights

### Reserva—the Fronius storage solution

Use solar energy around the clock with the Fronius Reserva. The high-voltage battery with DC
coupling ensures a highly efficient energy transfer. Thanks to its modular capacity of 6.3 to 15.8
kWh, the Reserva can be flexibly adapted to your needs. Designed to work seamlessly with Fronius
hybrid inverters, it slots perfectly into your PV system. Your data remains secure on European
servers, while our proven service and support network is always there for you.

[Learn more about the Fronius Reserva][7]
[Fronius Reserva]

### Fronius Fortis—the next-gen manual MIG/MAG welding machine

Welding tasks are often a challenge, especially for small and medium-sized companies. Some of the
tasks change on a daily basis, as do the required welding processes. This calls for a welding
machine that can be adapted perfectly to these dynamic conditions.

# Expertise                                                                                         
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
I am an innovation researcher with an interest in policy, history, society, theory and research     
methodology. As a multidisciplinary researcher I have written 200+ articles on eco-innovation,      
sustainability transitions and transformative social innovation in a wide range of disciplinary and 
multidisciplinary journals: innovation journals, environmental and ecological economics journals,   
policy journals, transport journals, and sustainable development journals. I am editor of           
*Environmental Innovation and Societal Transformation*s, *Sustainability Science* and advisory      
editor of *Research Policy* (top-tier journals on innovation and sustainability). As a professor of 
innovation and sustainable development I try to do socially relevant research and offer policy      
advice to create a better world (see consultation for policy).                                      
                                                                                                    
I wrote seminal articles and books on technological regime shifts, strategic niche management,      
transition management and reflexive governance for sustainable development. To me innovation is not 
a simple solution but comes with risks, imperfections and side-effects that have to be addressed.   
                                                                                                    
In the last 8 years, I developed a great interest in the humanisation of the economy through social 
innovation. There is a [video][18] for those interested in my views and an [interview][19].         
                                                                                                    
I have an interest in institutional theory: the role of institutional logics and the agency of      
actors in changing them. An interesting question is: *How is it possible that institutions…can arise
without a common will aiming at their creation [is] the significant, perhaps the most significant   
problem of the social sciences* – Carl Menger

## Featured Programs and Rebates

Program

### Level Pay

Monthly billing is here! Level Pay is a new, convenient monthly bill payment option that helps you
budget for your LADWP bill and pay off past due amounts.

[ Learn more ][71]
Program

### Landscape Efficiency Assistance Program

Free services for lawn removal and replacement with California Friendly® landscaping.

[ Learn more ][72]
Program

### EZ Save

The EZ-SAVE Program helps income-qualified customers save on their LADWP bills.

[ Learn more ][73]
Program

### Solar Programs

A key element of LADWP’s renewable energy program is the development of local solar, particularly
customer based programs that tap into the city’s abundant sunshine and provide residents and
businesses with the ability to generate their own power.

[ Learn more ][74]
Program

### Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP)

Helps eligible income-qualified households to manage and meet their immediate home heating and/or
cooling needs.

[ Learn more ][75]
Program

### Senior Citizen / Disability Lifeline Rate

The Lifeline Rate Program is a City of LA Office of Finance program that offers senior and disabled
citizens an exemption on their electric and other utility bills. This rate is available under
provisions of the Los Angeles Municipal Code or the Revenue and Taxation Code of the State of
California.

[ Learn more ][76]
Program

### Cool LA

Cool LA is designed to help LADWP customers better manage the impacts of extreme heat caused by
climate change, especially older adults, income-qualified families, and those living in underserved
communities where hot weather has an especially significant impact.

[ Learn more ][77]
Program

### Water Insights

LADWP’s My Water Insights is a free home water management program designed to help customers better
understand their water use through home water reports and a user-friendly online portal.

[ Learn more ][78]

### Optimización de Gas Natural

Reduzca los costos de provisión de gas natural, administrando diariamente el abastecimiento
diversificando los proveedores. Administre su empresa como lo hacen los grandes consumidores y
Ahorre!

### Energías Renovables

Latin Energy pone a disposición la mas variada y flexible red de servicios para la gestión de
Energías Renovables. Provisión, gestión de contratos, compulsas de precios, cálculos de ahorro y
todo lo que necesita para cumplir la ley.

Comercialización de Gas Natural.

Venta de Gas Natural para la industria, enfocados en la confiabilidad y la reducción de
costos. Latin Energy brinda servicios de abastecimiento de gas flexibles que se adaptan a la
necesidades de cada industria. Venta de gas en boca de pozo, transporte firme, peaking y mucho mas.

Asesoramiento Profesional en Energía Eléctrica y Gas Natural.

productiva. gestión contractual de los recursos energéticos para su eficiente administración,
buscando los mejores proveedores de energía del mercado, a los mejores precios y excelencia en la
calidad de servicio.

Latin Energy pone a disposición un equipo de profesionales con amplia experiencia en el sector
energético y especialistas de primer nivel en los sector de gas natural y energía eléctrica.

para un mejor adminsitración y eficiencia.

[LM Wind Power]

## Together, we capture the wind to power a sustainable world


With almost 50 years of innovation that continues to shape the wind industry, LM Wind Power is a
pioneer in advancing wind turbine blade technology and setting new standards for sustainability,
efficiency, and digital industrialization

[Learn More][49]


 

## Reducing the cost of energy, together

LM Wind Power is part of GE Vernova, in a joint effort to power a cleaner world and unleash
limitless energy.

With almost five decades of experience, we have established ourselves as the preferred supplier of
wind turbine blades worldwide. In fact, almost every fifth turbine in the world is fitted with LM
Wind Power blades. This includes thousands of GE turbines on land and in the sea. 

Our long-standing partnership with GE has yielded many innovations and commercial successes. Now, as
part of [GE Vernova][50], together we can offer higher performing, more productive wind turbines,
while continuing to reduce the cost of energy, increase energy independance, and improve returns on
our customers’ investments. At the same time, we are equally committed to maintaining and growing
our business with all customers.

 

[[GE Vernova]][51]

## Control your energy strategy.

[
Solutions
][31]
01
Deploy quickly

Deploy reliable, scalable onsite power in months, not years, with modular units that permit and
install quickly.

02
Add flexibility

Deliver prime power, solar firming, diesel reduction or elimination, grid services, and multi-fuel
operation with a single, fully dispatchable asset.

03
Control costs

Lower capex, lower maintenance costs, and higher efficiency combine to deliver a lower levelized
cost of electricity (LCOE) than alternative technologies.

04
Increase resilience 

Deploy fuel redundant power that can operate independently or in coordination with the grid.

05
Reduce emissions 

Generate low-emissions power today and transition seamlessly to zero-carbon fuels over time.

les domaines du solaire, de l’éolien terrestre et du stockage lui permettent d’accélérer la
transition énergétique des pays dans lesquels Neoen produit une énergie verte, locale et
compétitive. Nos capacités en construction, en operation ou sous gestion s’élèvent à 9,3 GW et nous
avons pour ambition d’atteindre 20 GW en 2030.

disposons d’un important portefeuille de projets en développement dans de nombreux pays.

chacune de nos régions et avons l’ambition d’être un leader mondial du stockage.

  [Stacked area chart of shares of egg production in the United Kingdom by housing system
  (free-range, cages, barns) from 1996 to 2025 where free-range rises from 10% in 1996 to 75% in
  2025, with cages declining and barns remaining a small share. Source: Defra (2023, 2026). License:
  CC BY.]
  
  Today
  
  ### Three-quarters of eggs produced in the United Kingdom are free-range
  
  Hannah Ritchie and Pablo Rosado
  
  Growing up in the United Kingdom in the 1990s and early 2000s, almost all the eggs in our
  supermarket came from battery hens, those raised in small wire enclosures.
  
  The living conditions in these cages are terrible. Birds get the space equivalent of an A4 sheet
  of paper. They don’t have the room to carry out their natural behaviors, such as nesting,
  perching, or dust bathing.
  
  That has changed in recent decades. You can see this in the chart, which shows the conditions
  under which eggs are produced in the UK. Free-range eggs have increased from just 10% to 75%.
  
  The use of caged hens has fallen, and the types of caged enclosures have also changed. Battery
  cages were banned in 2012, so legally, all cages since then have been “enriched” ones, which
  provide slightly more space. Still, these do not give hens the freedom and room they’d have in
  barns or free-range farms. Studies suggest that moving hens from enriched cages to cage-free
  systems reduces the time they spend in pain by more than half.
  
  And given that most eggs in the UK are now free-range, it’s possible to reduce this pain even
  further.
  
  Read my article on what the conditions of hens look like under caged versus cage-free systems

## About Rolls Battery

#### History

Established in 1935, Surrette Battery Company Ltd. is proud to be one of North America’s leading
lead-acid battery producers and Canada’s only remaining independent battery manufacturer. Since
1959, the company has been located in Springhill, Nova Scotia, where we produce a wide range of
Rolls-branded premium deep cycle batteries for use in Renewable Energy, Marine, Motive Power and
Railroad applications. Rolls flooded and sealed AGM & GEL VRLA products are internationally
recognized for their dependability, cycle life and outstanding quality.

#### Availability

Rolls Batteries are sold exclusively via our valued distributors & battery dealers. As a
longstanding manufacturer, Surrette Battery Company has been successful in negotiating and
establishing key partnerships with leading battery distributors and dealers throughout North America
and around the World. Due to product specifications and weight, these agreements and the ability to
ship and warehouse in large volumes have allowed us to improve lead times and minimize the
associated freight costs, improving access and delivery to product for dealers and their customers.

#### Manufacturing

Surrette Battery Company Ltd. manufacturing plant is an ISO registered facility where safety is as
important as product quality. Meeting the needs of our distributors who serve growing Renewable
Energy and Motive Power markets around the globe, we’ve completed numerous expansions and upgrades
in recent years and continue to advance our manufacturing facility and processes to meet demand.

We take pride in our reputation as industry leaders in providing high quality, dependable products
and see customer satisfaction and support as the key to future success. Rigorous inspection and
testing ensure that each battery will deliver the performance our customers have come to expect of
the Rolls brand.

## WE TAKE ACTION

### The SEMA Coalition is reviving American solar manufacturing, advocating for policies to reshore
### a competitive and innovative solar supply chain to help meet our growing energy demand, create
### thousands of well-paying jobs, and secure our nation’s energy independence.

[About SEMA][26]

## What does SEMA

[advocate image]

## advocate for?

Our coalition is focused on supporting American solar manufacturers and rebuilding the domestic
solar supply chain. Founded in 2021, the SEMA Coalition initially advocated for the Solar Energy
Manufacturing for America Act, which now enacted as part of the Section 45X Advanced Manufacturing
Production Tax Credit. The coalition promotes U.S. manufacturing and job growth in solar. As a
leading voice, we urge policymakers to adopt a whole-of-government approach to restore the domestic
solar supply chain and build a secure, made-in-America energy future.

## **The Right ABA Setting Makes
## All the Difference**

One setting doesn’t fit every child. Our ABA therapy adapts to your child’s needs, meeting them in
the places where they feel most grounded

#### **Center-based ABA**

Our center-based therapy gives your child a soft landing place to grow. With steady routines and
warm encouragement, each session brings them closer to confidence.

#### **In-home ABA**

In-home therapy lets your child learn in their own rhythm. No rush, no pressure, just simple, steady
progress in a space that feels safe.

#### **School-based ABA**

School can be overwhelming. We work alongside teachers to help your child feel more understood,
supported, and confident throughout their day.

## **Get Started in Days,
## Not Months**

Families choose Total Care ABA because we move quickly and deliver care that actually works. Our
team of licensed professionals provides out standing care backed by results and guided by
compassion.

### Renewable Energy Independence Day™

Thank you for Supporting Renewable Energy Independence Day

Renewable Energy Independence Day™ is an initiative of the US Renewable Energy Association
(USREA.org). The Nationwide Petition Drive asks Congress for a declaration of July 3rd as a date
where national efforts toward achieving renewable energy use of (50.4%), as compared to
non-renewable energy resources is acknowledged as a goal. This initiative supports the idea that
before the U.S. can truly have Independence Day on July 4th, the U.S. must achieve Renewable Energy
Independence.

The current national percentage of Renewable Energy Electricity use in 2019 (Approx 17%), represents
a current Renewable Energy Day of March 2nd, (if a one year supply of renewable energy electric were
used exclusively beginning January 1st, it would last until March 2nd). The goal of the United
States Renewable Energy Association, along with supporting companies and like minded individuals, is
to have a goal declaring July 3rd as the nationally recognized tipping point goal in clean energy
production. It is structured somewhat like Tax Freedom Day.

The petition is available at usrea.org and is supported by multiple National Alternative Energy
companies, associations and individuals. The goal is to have 200K signatures available before July
in a national social media campaign delivered to the U.S. Congress.

United States
In the United States, Renewable Energy Day for 2020 is March 2nd for a total average effective use
rate of 17% of the nation\'s energy use based on published data from the U.S. Energy Information
Administration. (In 2015, the energy use was February 18th and 13% )

Renewable Energy Day is the first day of the year in which a nation as a whole has theoretically
switched from Renewable Energy use, from all sources, and moved to the balance of yearly energy
production from non-renewable sources such as coal, petroleum, natural gas, nuclear, etc.

Purpose
According to Gerald B. Zack, President/CEO, USREA, “The purpose of Renewable Energy Independence Day
is to provide US citizens a metric with which to estimate progress in the use and deployment of
Renewable Energy Technologies. The premise is that by comparing the relative energy use in a date
reference, progress toward the tipping point of July 3rd can more easily be assessed.“

The petition language will be sent to the U.S. House of Representatives and U.S. Senate in the
following form:

3rd is 50.4% into the calendar year, and as such can become an ambitious but achievable goal.
